elements.name: Loombreaker
elements.desc: Your threadblade manifests as a massive, impossible melee weapon that deals 1d12 slashing damage. While you are wielding this weapon, your attacks with it during your turn have a reach of 10 feet, and your melee attacks targeting prone creatures ignore all sources of disadvantage.

elements.name: Scissorblade
elements.desc: Your threadblade manifests as a singular melee weapon that deals 1d10 slashing damage. After making an attack with this weapon targeting a creature, you move to any space of your choosing within 5 feet of the target without provoking opportunity attacks.

elements.name: Knitting Needles
elements.desc: Your threadblade manifests as a pair of edged melee weapons that deal 2d4 piercing damage. You always attack with them simultaneously, and can’t engage in standard two-weapon fighting using these weapons. Once per turn when you hit a creature with this threadblade, you can bind it, reducing its movement speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

elements.name: Pin Cushion
elements.desc: Your threadblade manifests as a mass of floating blades that hover in your space. This melee weapon deals 1d8 piercing damage, and you can use it to make ranged weapon attacks targeting creatures within 30 feet of you. When you hit a creature with an attack made using this weapon, you can drag the target up to 10 feet closer to you, or push it up to 10 feet directly away from you.

elements.name: Steelweave Strikers
elements.desc: Your threadblade manifests as bladed gauntlets and sabatons that deal 1d10 piercing damage. These melee weapons can’t be used to make unarmed strikes. After making an attack with this threadblade, you can exchange places with your target if there is sufficient space for each of you. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

elements.name: Restitch
elements.desc:
1 Arcane String

You repair and strengthen your infusion, granting you temporary hit points equal to your weaveshaper level + your Weave Tier, which last until you roll initiative.

elements.name: Ribbon Lash
elements.desc:
2 Arcane Strings

Make a melee attack with your threadblade or an accessory weapon granted by this class targeting a creature with a reach of 30 feet. If you hit, your target takes an extra 2d4 slashing damage and must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, it is thrown 10 feet horizontally in a direction of your choosing.

Higher Tiers: The extra slashing damage increases by 1d4 and the target is thrown another 5 feet if it fails its saving throw per Weave Tier you possess above 1.

elements.name: Flicker Strike
elements.desc:
2 Arcane Strings

You teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied location you can see and make a melee spell attack targeting a creature within your reach. If you hit, your target takes 1d8 radiant damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it is blinded until the start of your next turn.

Higher Tiers: The force damage increases by 1d8 and the distance you can teleport increases by 15 feet per Weave Tier you possess above 1.

elements.name: Vindicator Slash
elements.desc:
2 Arcane Strings

You tear at the arcana around you, cutting the air. Choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it fails, it takes 1d10 slashing damage and is knocked prone.

Higher Tiers: The slashing damage increases by 1d10 per Weave Tier you possess above 1.

elements.name: Killing Intent
elements.desc:
2 Arcane Strings

You manifest pure, deadly intention towards a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature in a 5-foot line between you and your target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If a creature fails, it is shunted to the nearest open space of its choosing outside the line of effect. If no creatures remain between you and your target, your target takes 1d10 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Higher Tiers: The psychic damage increases by 1d10 per Weave Tier you possess above 1.

elements.name: Dueling Ascent
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

Make a melee spell attack targeting a creature within your threadblade’s reach. If you hit, you launch it 20 feet straight into the air. You can immediately choose to follow it into the air and make one melee attack with your threadblade. If your target hits a ceiling, it takes falling damage as though it had fallen the remaining distance, then falls to the ground.

Higher Tiers: The target is hurled another 10 feet higher per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Sky Slayer
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

You teleport up to 30 feet into the air above a point within 15 feet of you, then unleash a lightning-infused slash at the ground below. Creatures within 5 feet of the point must make a Dexterity saving throw. If they fail, they take 3d10 lightning damage, or half as much damage on a success.

Higher Tiers: The lightning damage increases by 1d10 per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Reaping Wind
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

You launch yourself up to 30 feet in a direction of your choosing. Each hostile creature within 5 feet of your path must make a Dexterity saving throw. If a creature fails, it takes 3d8 slashing damage, or half as much damage on a success.

Higher Tiers: The slashing damage increases by 1d8 per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Phoenix Wings
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

You unleash a blast of fire in a 10-foot sphere centered on you, then fly up to 30 feet. Unattended objects and hostile creatures within this sphere take 2d4 fire damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your Weave Tier.

Higher Tiers: The fire damage increases by 1d4 per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Rising Devil
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

You stab the ground with your threadblade, and a pillar of pure arcane energy that is 30 feet high and 10 feet across bursts forth from the ground at a location you can see within 30 feet of you. Each creature within the space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If a creature fails, it takes 3d10 force damage and is pushed to the nearest open space outside the area.

Higher Tiers: The force damage increases by 1d10 per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Dragon’s Maw
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 6th level

3 Arcane Strings

Your threadblade expands, forming jaws and teeth, and it bites down on a creature of your choosing within 10 feet of you. The target takes 1d8 piercing damage and is restrained and grappled by you until the start of your next turn. The target must make a Constitution saving throw as the maw begins to chew. If it fails, it takes 3d10 slashing damage, or half as much damage on a success.

Higher Tiers: The slashing damage increases by 1d10 per Weave Tier you possess above 2.

elements.name: Cruel Shrike
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 10th level

3 Arcane Strings

Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it fails, it is restrained until the start of your next turn by massive barbed chains, and you can teleport to a space within 5 feet of the creature and make one melee attack with your threadblade. If you hit, your attack deals an extra 4d6 piercing damage.

Higher Tiers: The piercing damage increases by 1d6 per Weave Tier you possess above 4.

elements.name: Soul Sever
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 10th level

3 Arcane Strings

You make a melee weapon attack with your threadblade. If you hit, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. If it fails, you cut into its soul, dealing 5d8 necrotic damage to the creature and causing it to become frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Higher Tiers: The necrotic damage increases by 1d8 per Weave Tier you possess above 4.

elements.name: Thread Stripper
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 10th level

3 Arcane Strings

You stomp the ground, hurling a creature you can see within 30 feet of you 10 feet into the air. You then launch yourself up to 60 feet in the direction of the target and make a melee attack with your threadblade targeting that creature during your movement. If you hit, your attack deals an extra 4d4 slashing damage, and you can choose one nonmagical weapon or shield the creature is holding. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it fails, the object is destroyed and you gain 4d6 temporary hit points.

Higher Tiers: The temporary hit points increase by 1d6 and the slashing damage increases by 1d4 per Weave Tier you possess above 4.

elements.name: Omnicleave
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 15th level

3 Arcane Strings

You empower your weapon and swing to unleash a scything wave of force. Each creature within a cone up to 15 feet long must make a Dexterity saving throw. If a creature fails, it takes 7d6 slashing damage, or half as much damage on a success.

Higher Tiers: The maximum area of the cone grows by 5 feet and the slashing damage increases by 1d6 per Weave Tier you possess above 5.

elements.name: Shadow Assault
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: 15th level

3 Arcane Strings

You teleport to a location you can see within 30 feet of you, hovering there invisibly until the start of your next turn. If a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes an action during this time, you can use your reaction to launch yourself at that target and make a melee attack with your threadblade which deals an extra 4d6 slashing damage, after which your invisibility fades.

Higher Tiers: Your melee attack deals an extra 1d6 slashing damage per Weave Tier you possess above 5.
